<a name="Profile"></a>
## type [Profile](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L4>)

Profile adalah nama signature profile \(Tabel 2.1\), sekaligus isi field algorithm manifest.

```go
type Profile string
```

<a name="RSAPSS"></a>Tiga profile yang didukung.

```go
const (
    RSAPSS  Profile = "rsa-pss-sha256"
    ECDSA   Profile = "ecdsa-p256-sha256"
    Ed25519 Profile = "ed25519"
)
```

<a name="Parse"></a>
### func [Parse](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L14>)

```go
func Parse(s string) (Profile, bool)
```

Parse return Profile dari s, false kalau bukan salah satu dari tiga profile.

<a name="Profile.SignatureLen"></a>
### func \(Profile\) [SignatureLen](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/profile/profile.go#L24>)

```go
func (p Profile) SignatureLen() int
```

SignatureLen return panjang signature \(byte\): 384 RSA\-PSS, 64 ECDSA dan Ed25519, 0 kalau tidak dikenal.
